summary: Frontend-only Playwright test at 1920x1080. Played the whole game through the UI with a mix of right and wrong answers. PASSED: the Journey map lists S1 1.1-1.5 and S2 2.1-2.7 with the correct titles, including 2.6 'From 10 Steps to 3' and 2.7 'One App, One BRD'. Only 1.1 is playable at first; 2.1 is locked. The match-result banner was correct for all 12 levels: data-matched=true and 'You matched Nandish! He picked the same move.' on a match, 'Nandish went a different way.' otherwise. Picking option D on 2.5 showed 'Nandish did all of these. You matched Nandish!'. Finishing 2.7 navigates to /results with score 8 / 12 and the correct tier 'Same Wavelength'. Answers are saved in nj_answers_v1 and progress in nj_progress_v2. The download returns nandish-journey-results.png (71KB) with a success toast and no error toast. journey-results-link shows once S2 is complete and goes to /results. reset-progress-button on /pitch clears progress, answers and wishlist; afterwards Results shows 0/12 and the Journey link disappears. Regression passed: direct load of locked /level/2.6 redirects to /journey; wishlist total updates ($850, '1 item'); the design-prompt page 'How I Build This with Voice' loads and its .md download works. FAILED: the downloaded PNG is badly framed. The card is shifted right with a white strip on the left, and the right side is cut off, so the avatar and the 2.4 chip are missing.

ui_bugs.issue: At desktop width the exported PNG is offset and cropped. The left part is white/transparent and the right edge is cut off, so the avatar and the last chip in row 1 are missing. Cause: the card uses 'mx-auto', and html-to-image copies the computed margin-left (in px) into the clone, so the content moves right inside a canvas that is only the card's width.

action_items: Results.jsx: pass style overrides to toPng so margins are removed in the clone, e.g. toPng(cardRef.current, { pixelRatio: 2, cacheBust: true, style: { margin: '0' } }). Another option is to put mx-auto on a wrapper div instead of the ref'd card. Then check that the downloaded PNG shows the full card, including the avatar and all 12 chips.
Optional: html-to-image logs SecurityError when reading cross-origin Google Fonts cssRules. It is harmless, but you can pass skipFonts or a fontEmbedCSS to quiet it.
critical_code_review_comments: /results can be opened at any time, even with 0 answers. That is fine, but consider a CTA to play when answeredCount is 0.
The GameContext useMemo has deps [completed, cart, answers]. That is correct for now, but the functions are recreated on every render anyway.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all flows pass; the PNG export is visually broken)

seed_data_creation: None. Only the test browser's localStorage was changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct picks: 1.1=1, 1.2=2, 1.3=0, 1.4=1, 1.5=1, 2.1-2.4=1, 2.5=any, 2.6=1, 2.7=1. To seed a completed game, set nj_progress_v2 to all 12 ids and nj_answers_v1 to an object. To check the PNG, save the download from expect_download and view the image; the margin offset only shows at desktop width.
rca of the issue: PNG crop: html-to-image clones the node with its inline computed styles, including margin-left/right in px from mx-auto at a 1920 viewport. The canvas is sized to the node's offsetWidth, so the margin pushes the content right and crops it. Mitigation: style:{margin:'0'} in the toPng options.
